description: This file defines the InMemoryTransportConnection class, which implements an in-memory transport connection for testing purposes within the Orleans framework. It manages connection lifecycle, piping, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportConnection
classes.description: A class representing an in-memory transport connection used for testing Orleans networking, supporting connection creation, closure, and disposal.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new in-memory transport connection with specified memory pool, logger, and endpoints.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new in-memory transport connection by swapping pipes from an existing connection, used for bidirectional communication.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts the connection, cancels pending reads and writes, and initiates closure.

methods.name: OnClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup and signaling when the connection is closed.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the connection, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the connection endpoints.
